Rationale: silent data loss on a user-reachable export surface (sparse columns are the normal shape of report output, and the first-50-rows sample correlates with sort order). The fix-route choice (scan all rows vs. project from the saved report's declared column set) is implementation judgment within the same contract — both restore "the export carries every field present in the result set" — so it queues rather than entering the decision inbox; if the implementer concludes the saved-report schema route requires a new declared surface, stop and report a fork per premise-first. Suggested pin: an export over >50 rows where a key first appears past the sample boundary.
